column1: # Go hold-live variant: all N goroutines parked and confirmed alive before
# peak RSS is sampled, then released. This is the apples-to-apples
# counterpart to bench_forge.fg, whose `process main` body must queue all
# N coroutines before fr_scheduler_run() drains any of them.
# bench_go.go (in raw.tsv) measures something different and easier:
# goroutines retire while the loop is still spawning, so peak-alive is far
# below N and its RSS must NOT be compared against Forge's.
